examples.title: Sine and Cosine
examples.description: The PET has no graphics mode, so these two curves are drawn by poking character codes into screen memory at 32768; press any key to clear.

examples.title: Temperatures
examples.description: Type a temperature in Celsius and get it back in Fahrenheit and Kelvin; press RETURN on an empty line to stop.

examples.title: Guess the Number
examples.description: The PET picks a number from 1 to 100 and tells you higher or lower after every guess.

manuals.title: PET 2001-8 Personal Computer User Manual (1978)
manuals.note: The original 8 KB machine's manual, BASIC included. Scan at the Internet Archive.
